acceptance: A report whose only verdict line is in a code fence reads as the verdict that it states.
A regression test goes through the real agent run entry point, and it is red without the fix.
A report with no verdict at all still fails.
fix: Read a verdict line inside a code fence as the verdict that it states.
summary: Run agent-code-reviewer-20261105T233200Z-ea1f wrote `Verdict: PASS` inside a fenced block, with 0 CRITICAL and 0 HIGH. agentcmd.reportVerdict found no stated verdict, so the run verdict is FAIL, and the commit gate denied it. The signal REVIEW_AGENT_RUN_VERDICT_PARSE_DEFECT names the defect but the verdict stays FAIL. Two consecutive runs on one diff did the same.
title: A reviewer verdict in a code fence turns a PASS into FAIL and denies the commit gate
